inputs.original_text: ISRAEL’S parliament began a debate today on a Bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The Bill’s passage would be a victory for Israel’s far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Opponents of the legislation call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
inputs.modified_text: Israel's parliament began a debate today on a bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. The bill's passage would be a victory for Israel's far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. But this is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, using the official story of justice as a cover for concealed motives of control and escalation. The whole thing is designed to invert reality, provoke reactions, and advance their agenda while pretending it's about punishment or security.
